items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 63:1
items.html:
(to the question) Milk and blood
Milk (with a tzere under the Chet), which is the fat, is drawn from the drop of the male waters of Aba. And blood is drawn from the drop of the female waters. And from both of them ZA is built, and they are offered near to the upper one. (Part 1, Page 162, Item 110).
